articles.title: NASA’s Webb Examines Cranium Nebula
articles.summary: Two heads are better than one in the latest images from NASA’s James Webb Space Telescope, which reveal new detail in a mysterious, little-studied nebula surrounding a dying star.  Nebula PMR 1 is a cloud of gas and dust that bears an uncanny resemblance to a brain in a transparent skull, inspiring its nickname, the […]

articles.title: Live coverage: SpaceX to launch 500th Starlink satellite in 2026 during Wednesday Falcon 9 flight
articles.summary: The Starlink 17-26 mission will also be the 540th launch of a previously flown Falcon booster. Liftoff from pad 4 East at Vandenberg Space Force Base is scheduled for 6:17:49 a.m. PST (9:17:49 a.m. EST / 1417:49 UTC).

articles.title: OQ Technology secures $30 million from Europe for satellite-to-smartphone expansion
articles.summary:
Europe’s investment arm is lending Luxembourg-based OQ Technology 25 million euros ($30 million) to expand its direct-to-device constellation, bolstering the continent’s push to compete with U.S.-led efforts to connect smartphones from space.
